## Work

Projects built at Samsung Electronics (2024–present):

- [Shared UI Library](/work/ui-component-library): 45-component React library on Radix UI + Tailwind CSS v4 serving ~12 product teams. 79 test files, 47 Storybook stories, dual ESM/CJS output.
- [Headless Dashboard Library](/work/headless-dashboard-library): Solo-built headless framework for layout, drag-drop, resize, widget registration, persistence, and widget-to-widget events. 11 built-in widgets, 4 apps in production.
- [AI Dev Platform](/work/ai-dev-platform-mfe-adoption): End-to-end agentic frontend workflow automating ~65% of routine work. Scaffolds, reviews, audits, and coordinates deployments.
- [MCP Toolkit](/work/one-protocol-two-surfaces): ~30 MCP server packages, 60+ registered tools, 27 CLI wrappers powering both Cline AI and CI automation.

## Skills
